answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil attacks via optical speckle attestation. Each node illuminates a disordered microstructure with a violet laser, publishing the interference signal. Because multiple scattering in physical media resists numerical emulation, an attacker incurs the verifiable cost of fabricating distinct scattering tokens and optical detectors per identity. However, ambient thermal drift causes the beam to wander, occasionally triggering false rejections.
